title: Figma Plugin Phase 10 - Hardcoded Values Elimination (Tabs, Toast, Shadow Validation)
overview: Eliminate remaining hardcoded values in Tabs and Toast generators by reading from component-registry.json. Add CSS token for dialog shadow. Add validation tests to prevent drift in buttonCompactSize values.

context.problem: Tabs and Toast generators have hardcoded configuration values (TABS_CONFIG, TOAST_WIDTH) despite registry.components.Tabs.styling and registry.components.Toasty.styling already existing with the correct values. Additionally, SHADOWS.dialog has undocumented values not backed by any CSS token, and FALLBACK_VALUES.buttonCompactSize is not validated against the component source.
context.current_state: Phase 9 complete. Font sizes aligned with theme-kumo.css. However, several generators still use hardcoded values instead of registry, and some constants lack drift protection.
context.why_now: The registry integration pattern is proven (Phase 7 completed for DateRangePicker, Pagination, InputArea, LayerCard, MenuBar). Tabs and Toast should follow the same pattern for consistency and maintainability.

architecture_pattern.proven_in_phase_7: Generator reads from registry.components.X.styling with fallback to hardcoded values
architecture_pattern.benefit: Single source of truth - when CSS/component changes, registry regenerates, and generators automatically pick up new values

button_compact_size.solution: Add drift detection test to validate against component

primary: Update tabs.ts to read configuration from registry.components.Tabs.styling

Add drift detection test for SHADOWS.dialog against CSS token
